findings.title: Missing dependency lockfile or unpinned dependency version ranges
findings.evidence: No lockfile (Pipfile.lock, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, poetry.lock, uv.lock, yarn.lock) found in repository
findings.why_it_matters: Without a committed lockfile, installs resolve the latest transitive versions at build time, exposing CI and developers to newly published malicious releases.

findings.title: Missing automated dependency update config (Dependabot/Renovate) and `SECURITY.md`
findings.why_it_matters: Lack of automated dependency hygiene and a vulnerability disclosure policy delays remediation when upstream dependencies are compromised.

findings.title: LLM output passed directly to `eval`, `exec`, `subprocess(shell=True)`, `os.system`, or raw SQL
findings.why_it_matters: `subprocess` invoked with `shell=True` enables command injection when arguments contain LLM-generated or user-controlled strings.

improvements.title: LLM output passed directly to `eval`, `exec`, `subprocess(shell=True)`, `os.system`, or raw SQL
improvements.description: Replace `eval`/`exec`/`subprocess(..., shell=True)` on LLM output with a strict schema parser (Pydantic) and argument-list subprocess calls (`shell=False`).
improvements.snippet:
# Replace eval(llm_response) / subprocess.run(..., shell=True):
import json, subprocess
parsed = AllowedCommandModel.model_validate_json(llm_response)
subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/echo", parsed.safe_arg], shell=False, check=True)

improvements.title: Missing dependency lockfile or unpinned dependency version ranges
improvements.description: Commit a deterministic lockfile (`package-lock.json`, `uv.lock`, or `poetry.lock`) and pin exact dependency versions.
improvements.snippet:
# Generate and commit lockfile:
npm i --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
# In CI use deterministic install:
npm ci --ignore-scripts

improvements.title: Missing automated dependency update config (Dependabot/Renovate) and `SECURITY.md`
improvements.description: Add `.github/dependabot.yml` for automated security updates and a `SECURITY.md` disclosure policy.
improvements.snippet:
# .github/dependabot.yml
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
